metadata.summary: CT-RATE provides 50,188 volumetric chest CT scans (25,692 unique scans) from 21,304 patients, each paired with a structured radiology report (2.7M impression statements). It includes multi-organ segmentation masks (CT-RATE-2) and a radiology report labeling pipeline.
metadata.purpose: Support multi-organ abnormality detection, report generation, and vision-language modeling.
metadata.avoided_uses: Commercial use is prohibited per license.

papers.title: CT-RATE: A Multi-organ CT with 2.7M Radiology Text Reports and Lung Nodule Masks

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified data; no PHI explicitly mentioned.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification

known_limitations: Report labels auto-extracted (RadBERT), introducing possible noise.
Reports translated from Turkish to English, potentially losing nuance or introducing bias.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — reports translated; labels extracted algorithmically; masks generated via semi-automated pipeline.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ single-center Turkish population; no representation from other countries, health systems, or demographic groups.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability beyond single-center Turkish clinical practice and English-translated reporting conventions.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity).

data_origin.selection_rationale: Single-center clinical chest CTs with associated radiology reports.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: All available chest CTs from Istanbul Medipol University meeting inclusion criteria (not further specified in source text).

population.target_population: Patients undergoing chest CT at Istanbul Medipol University.
population.missing_groups: No external/site diversity; underrepresentation of non-Turkish populations and other clinical settings.

annotation.annotation_method: Radiology report labels extracted from free text using RadBERT; lung nodule and multi-organ masks generated via semi-automated pipeline (CT-RATE-2).

annotators.qualifications: RadBERT model applied to English-translated reports

annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels auto-extracted from free-text radiology reports using RadBERT; reports originally written in Turkish and translated to English.
annotation.label_noise_description: Possible label noise due to RadBERT extraction and Turkish-to-English translation pipeline.
